title: OTTO-CLEAN ARM
frame: Parked car frame: origin at the car centre on grade, +Y up, +X toward the nose, +Z toward the right flank. Zero pose: links along +X, mast retracted, wand level.

subsystems.name: Canopy mount
subsystems.function: A header beam under 2 canopy purlins and a drop column carry the arm over the stall. Nothing stands where a car drives.
how: 4 angle clips bolt the header to the purlins.
The drop column bolts to the header and carries the J1 base.
The vacuum riser runs down the column to the arm.

subsystems.name: J1 shoulder yaw
subsystems.function: Swings link 1 about the column. With J2 it puts the mast anywhere over the car.
how: A size 32 actuator in the base casting drives link 1 from above.
Its motor bell sits inside the drop column.

subsystems.name: Link 1
subsystems.function: The 0.95 m box link from J1 to J2.
how: Welded aluminium box with a bolted top cover.
An energy chain on top carries the hose and cables to J2.

subsystems.name: J2 elbow yaw
subsystems.function: Folds link 2 under link 1, so the arm can tuck in over the roof.
how: A size 25 actuator in the link 1 tip drives link 2 below it.

subsystems.name: Link 2
subsystems.function: The 0.80 m box link from J2 to the mast.
how: It rides 190 mm under link 1.

subsystems.name: J3 mast yaw
subsystems.function: Turns the mast, so the wand points along or across the car.
how: A slewing bearing carries the mast in the link 2 carriage.
A servo gearmotor turns it through a 3:1 toothed belt.

subsystems.name: Telescoping mast
subsystems.function: Lowers the wrist from 2.18 m to 0.58 m above grade, beside the car, never over it.
how: A rack and pinion drives the middle stage.
A belt over a pulley on the middle stage moves the inner stage twice as far.
Acetal wear pads guide each stage. A brake holds it when power is off.

subsystems.name: J4 wrist pitch
subsystems.function: Tilts the wand from level to hanging down, and into the door opening.
how: A size 20 actuator beside the hub turns it.
The wand passes through the hub, so it can slide back past the pivot.

subsystems.name: Telescoping vacuum wand
subsystems.function: Reaches into the cabin through the open door. The wand is the vacuum duct.
how: 3 tubes slide inside each other on lip seals. The air flows inside them.
An electric linear drive moves the middle tube.
A cable over a pulley moves the inner tube twice as far.

subsystems.name: Nozzle head (J5)
subsystems.function: Cleans the floor, the benches and the seat backs: vacuum, an air knife and a brush lip.
how: A gearmotor with a worm stage pitches the head.
The air knife blows dust out of seams into the vacuum flow.
A light ring shows that it works, and lights the cabin for the camera.

subsystems.name: Vacuum and air supply
subsystems.function: Brings vacuum and compressed air from the canopy plant to the nozzle.
how: A central vacuum producer on each canopy (about 3 kW per working arm, 30 kPa class) serves its arms.
A riser pipe, a hose and the wand carry the flow. A 6 mm line carries the air.

subsystems.name: Status lights
subsystems.function: Show the arm state to the site and to the camera.
how: A ring on the J1 base, a strip on the mast and a ring at the nozzle.
